meta.title: SyncKai: your anime list, updated at the credits
meta.description: Browser extension for Chrome and Firefox. Watch anime on Crunchyroll or ADN and SyncKai updates your AniList and MyAnimeList list when the ending credits start. Free, open source, no server.

hero.title: Your anime list, updated at the credits.
hero.lead: Watch on Crunchyroll or ADN as usual. When the ending credits start, SyncKai saves the episode to AniList and MyAnimeList. You never type an episode number again.
hero.note: Free and open source. Also works in Edge, Brave and other Chromium browsers.

demo.label: Demo of an episode being synced at the ending credits

how.title: Three steps, then nothing to do

steps.title: Install the extension
steps.text: From the Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons. No SyncKai account to create.

steps.title: Connect your lists
steps.text: AniList, MyAnimeList, or both. Each one is optional.

steps.title: Watch your episode
steps.text: At the start of the credits, the episode is marked as watched. If SyncKai isn't sure about the season, it asks you once, then remembers.

features.title: Everything around the episode

items.title: The episode, beside the video
items.text: The side panel shows the AniList entry, your live progress before the sync, the next season to watch and a link to the episode discussion.

items.title: This week's releases
items.text: The schedule lists the new episodes of the series you're watching, with the estimated time on Crunchyroll or ADN. Episodes you've already seen are ticked off.

items.title: Edit your list without leaving the page
items.text: On a series page, add it to your list or change progress, status and score in a couple of clicks.

items.title: Catch up on your history
items.text: Import your Crunchyroll, ADN or Netflix history. You see a preview first, and nothing uncertain is written without your say.

more: Season matching, including absolute numbering like One Piece and seasons split across several entries
Netflix and Disney+, if you turn them on (anime only)
A list of your series in progress, with the date of the next episode and +1 / −1 buttons
AniList and MyAnimeList compared side by side, aligned in one click
A rating prompt at the end of a series, and rewatch support
Alerts when a new episode of your series is out
Syncs retried automatically after a network drop
Keyboard shortcuts: Alt+Shift+K marks the current episode as watched
Backup and restore of your settings and history
Interface in English, French and German

privacy.title: Nothing leaves your browser, except for your list
privacy.text: SyncKai has no server. Your settings, history and sign-ins stay in your browser, and the extension only talks to AniList and MyAnimeList.
points: Source code public under the MIT license

items.a: Chrome 116 or later, plus Edge, Brave and other Chromium browsers through the Chrome Web Store. Firefox 142 or later on desktop.
Yes, completely. No paid version, no ads.

items.q: My episode wasn't synced. What should I do?
items.a: Open the SyncKai popup: the status bar tells you if a match needs checking, a sync is pending or a session expired. After updating the extension, reload the player tab. As a last resort, Alt+Shift+K marks the current episode as watched.
In Activity › Recent syncs, click Fix and choose the right entry. SyncKai remembers it for the next episodes. Then use −1 to undo the wrong progress.

items.q: Do I need both AniList and MyAnimeList?
items.a: No. Connect one or the other, or both: each account is optional.

cta.title: Your next episode is already synced.
cta.text: Install SyncKai, connect your list, and press play.
